item.title: Container Surge Continues At The Port Of Long Beach
item.dc:creator: Lori Ann LaRocco
item.description: The Port of Los Angeles reported its best single month in its history. In a media briefing, port executive director Gene Seroka announced the port processed 1,042,652 TEUs, 23k TEUs more than the July 2025 record.

item.title: Vessel Struck by Unknown Projectile Off UAE Coast Amid Surge in Attacks, UKMTO Says
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.description: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile 13 nautical miles west of Al Jazeera in the United Arab Emirates on Friday, causing a fire that has since been extinguished, British navy affiliated agency UKMTO said, citing multiple sources.

item.title: From Policy to Practice: Shipping’s Regulatory Autumn Puts Proof on Trial
item.dc:creator: Paul Morgan
item.description: The past fortnight has delivered a clear reminder that the industry’s regulatory problem is no longer a shortage of rules. It is the widening distance between what is agreed in London and Brussels and what can actually be demonstrated on deck, in the engine room and in a ship’s emissions data.

item.title: Isaias Puts 500,000 Barrels a Day of Refining Capacity at Risk
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: Nearly 500,000 barrels a day of oil-refining capacity sit in the projected path of Hurricane Isaias, raising the risk that a US fuel market with no supplies to spare will lose critical output.

item.title: Global Oil Tanker Shortage is Getting Worse By the Day
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: For a sign of just how extraordinary oil shipping costs have become, consider this: It’s now more expensive to hire a tanker from the US to China than to launch a rocket into space.

item.title: Houthis Kill Three in Strikes on Saudi Arabian Airports
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.description: The Houthis struck two airports in Saudi Arabia in the past two days, killing three people and injuring dozens as the Iran-backed militant group intensifies its attacks on the kingdom from Yemen.
